facts.cue: Some very big letters were standing up.
facts.text: A row of giant white letters stood on the floor, each dotted with small lights.

facts.cue: A big blue banner had a name and a number on it.
The little lights had a cool color.
facts.text: The small lights on the letters glowed blue.

facts.cue: There were steps running alongside them.
facts.text: The letters stood in a long row on a raised platform edged with wide steps.
The banner also mentioned San Francisco.
Thin wires ran between the lights on the letters.

facts.cue: There were soft seats on the floor.
facts.text: Beanbag chairs were on the floor of the hall.
The hall was huge, with steel beams and long rows of ceiling lights.

facts.cue: There were tables set up off to the side.
facts.text: Tall banner stands stood near folding tables and chairs.

moment.place: A large hall with steel beams, near a banner reading "Cal HACKS 13.0" and "San Francisco"
moment.summary: The camera moves slowly around a row of giant white letters standing on a raised platform, each dotted with small lights. In the background, a large hall holds a "Cal HACKS 13.0" banner, people resting on the floor, and a few people walking by. No speech was recorded.
moment.title: Giant lighted letters in a large hall
